title: WATCH How God is Using Your Storm Situation To Turn Your Life Around (Christian Motivation)
paragraphs: have you ever heard the story of the young eagle there was once a young Eagle who dreamed of soaring high above the mountain peaks when it came time for his first flying lesson he eagerly jumped from The Nest confident he would gracefully glide through the clouds but instead a fierce wind immediately swept him into a violent spin he desperately flapped his wings trying to regain control but he plunged downward AT trucking speed the wind roaring and whipping all around him the

young Eagle hit the side of the mountain hard and tumbled helplessly to the valley floor far below bruised and dazed he lay there thinking I'll never fly now This is the End just then his mother the Elder Eagle landed beside him with deep empathy she lovingly comforted her son once the young Eagle regained some strength the mother gently said my son that treacherous wind is not the end for you I know it's difficult to see right now but you need that

adversity in turbulence it's an essential part of learning to fly the young Eagle protested but the wind almost killed me the mother Eagle responded yes but that same wind is going to teach you how to master the skies with my help you'll develop the strength and skill to ride the fiercest gusts and currents you'll learn to use them not be used by them this storm is not the end my son it's only the beginning of experiencing the breathtaking Heights and freedom

of flight that I have prepared for you this story reminds us of Isaiah 40 verse 31. but those who wait on the Lord shall renew their strength they shall Mount up with wings like eagles they shall run and not be weary they shall walk and not faint my friends we all face storms that knock us down the death of a loved one a cancer diagnosis a strange relationship a financial crisis in those moments we feel helpless like the young Eagle we

just want the wind to stop but what if these storms have a purpose what if they are not the end but the beginning with God's help our storms can develop our faith build our character expand our ministry and prepare us for New Heights the strong wind is not meant to destroy you but help you rise above adversity into the life God has for you let's explore this together challenges and trials are inevitable parts of life in this Fallen World seasons of

climate stability certainly occur but storms always return illnesses broken relationships career turmoil family crisis when the fierce winds start howling in the threatening clouds darken the Skies of your life your natural instinct is to run and Escape you desperately pray for the Tempest to pass and for God to calm the swelling waves but what if there is Divine Purpose in the storms what if you're running away from purpose as hard as this may sound sometimes you need the storm those chaotic

gusts become teachers to strengthen your faith and character the booming Thunder becomes a calling to comfort others going through similar storms you need the storm because it grows your trust and dependence on God when life feels funny and calm we often rely on our own abilities and resources we become self-sufficient for getting our need for God but Fierce storms reveal how powerless we really are in the face of such overwhelming forces as everything spins out of control we finally hit bottom

arriving at the beautiful place of complete dependence on God painful but necessary storms blow away our false confidence in ourselves storms shift our Focus entirely on our refuge almighty God in Psalm 18 King David describes a season of violent storm he describes wave after wave of disaster enemies surrounded and attacked him death seemed imminent but in desperation he cried out to God for deliverance David declares in verse 16. he reached down from one high and took hold of me he drew

me out of deep Waters God rescued David from the raging storm and set his feet upon the rot what seemed to be a certain Doom became the Catalyst for deeper trust in God the storm drove David to fully Embrace God as his only anchor now the storms you face reveal your fundamental inability to control life's circumstances but take heart for then you turn to the one who rules the wind and waves you discover his power presence and deliverance in remarkable new

ways this deepens your roots in him the strong winds that uproot the weak tree strengthens the sturdy Oak to withstand anything my friends your storm will develop your trust and Reliance on God himself you will emerge firmly anchored in his love and sovereignty over your life never forget you need the storm because it shapes your character Fierce winds and pounding rain develop spiritual muscle we all need some spiritual muscle like an athlete lifting heavy weights to build strength difficulties build christ-like

qualities in US patience courage humility compassion and perseverance the trials that seem to be crushing us are shaping us into the image of Jesus he uses the storms to transform you at your very core in James 1 verses 2 to 4 the Bible says consider a joy When Storms Come because they will produce perseverance and character within you making you mature and complete Paul in second Corinthians 4 17 describes troubles as light and momentary afflictions teething for us an eternal glory

that far outweighs them all God has Eternal purposes in each Tempest just as the immense heat and pressure involved in transforming a lump of carbon into a dazzling Diamond your storms have Heavenly purpose in developing your soul into something beautifully christ-like and eternally impactful consider biblical examples like Joseph and David Young Joseph endured terrible storms of betrayal false accusation and unjust imprisonment but he emerged from The Tempest with faith refined like gold a humble heart of forgiveness and a passion to

fulfill God's purposes David endured storm after storm as King Saul tried to take his life but through it all David developed Integrity wisdom patience and Spiritual Authority the clouds and storms eventually produced a king after God's Own Heart now the relationship struggles financial crisis or the health diagnosis some of you may face will feel like a hurricane striking you but if you keep your eyes on Jesus the master of your soul you'll develop his heart of compassion courage and Spiritual Authority

the winds how but your roots grow deep in love and faith when it finally passes you'll shine with christ-like qualities that display God's grace in ways you never could have without the storm lean into him brave soul Let The Tempest teach you in Hebrews 12 verse 1-3 therefore we also since we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses let us lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily ensnares us and let us run with endurance the race

that is set before us looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross despising the shame and has sat down at the right hand of the Throne of God for consider him who endured such hostility from Sinners against himself lest you become wary and discouraged in your souls now in this scripture of Hebrews God is encouraging you to endure the storm and to put your focus on Jesus because

your end will be better than your beginning my dear friends we need storms because they expand our faith and shape our character now let's discuss how they enlarge our life in Ministry you need the storm because It prepares you for greater service God often allows storms in your life to help others going through similar hardships your pain cultivates compassion and capacity to comfort those in the midst of Trials as second Corinthians 1 verse 4 explains Comforts Us in all our troubles

so that we can Comfort others when they are troubled we will be able to give them the same Comfort God has given us if you've experienced divorce you can powerfully minister to other divorces if you've battled anxiety you can better encourage those struggling with mental health because you faced infertility you can now Comfort an adoptive or foster parent sometimes God allowed your storm to prepare you for expanded impact these lives you could never have otherwise reached the beauty of this is

your mess becomes your ministry and your hardship readies you for your Harvest storms also give you greater boldness and passion in sharing your faith you have a powerful testimony of God's faithfulness through the fiercest winds people connect better with someone who has navigated deep Waters they will listen when you say let me tell you about the Mighty God who strengthened me through the storm your story stirs other hearts to open up to this loving father in First Corinthians 9 verse 22

we see that Paul's sufferings equipped him to relate to everyone becoming all things to all people to save some the young Eagle after some experience will now have a credible and gripping story to encourage other young Eagles he will be able to say I know that suffering but let me tell you about the God who lifts you up the storm victim becomes the storm guide as Charles Spurgeon said I have learned to kiss the wave that throws me against The Rock

of Ages beloved kiss that wave let it crash you into Christ the solid rock then tell others of him the inevitable is true storms will come but you have two choices resist God's help or Embrace God's help you can senselessly Rage Against The Storm ending up battered and broken or you can submit to God's purposes allowing him to use your storms as instruments of growth when stormy winds blow choose to say like job in Job 1 verse 21. the Lord gives

and the Lord takes away blessed be the name of the Lord now I urge you to cling tightly to Jesus your anchor in the storm he puts the wind beneath your wings he will hold you steady through howling gusts trust him to develop your character and expand your capacity for service one day you'll stand atop the mountain look back on The Valleys you walk through and understand God's loving purposes in it all your storm will promote you to new places you've

only dreamed of God will take you deeper and lift you higher than ever before surrender to him embrace the storm today and discover the new life it brings tomorrow now to all those within the sound of my voice let us go to the Lord in prayer I want you to pray this prayer with me so that you can have all the blessings of this prayer let us pray to our gracious and loving God Heavenly Father you are the awesome and eternal

God we praise you for your goodness mercies and Sovereign authority over all things Lord When Storms of adversity come I often feel knocked down and defeated wondering if this struggle will ever end but I am realizing and trusting that you have allowed these storms for a purpose even when I desperately prayed for them to pass quickly you had growth and blessing in Mind through it all Lord I have learned to trust in you even in seasons of struggle you alone are

my rock refuge and strength even in times of weakness gracious Lord help me to overcome any subtle self-reliance in my heart so I turn to you as my only help and deliverer help me to see and submit to your perfect will and Authority grant me courage to Stand Tall through the tempests of Life confident that as I fix my eyes on you you will bring me victoriously through the wind and waves Lord use my challenging times to shape me into a

vessel that brings honor and glory to your name loving father you shall turn my mourning into dancing and my tears into laughter help me to develop compassion patience wisdom courage humility and spiritual maturity mold my character more into the image of Jesus through this refining process make my roots grow deep in your love fill me with your Holy Spirit and work in me and through me grant me New Perspective that I may walk in faith and take hold of your abundant

blessing Lord I am thankful for the good plans and outcome that you have for me plans to prosper me and not to harm me Lord please help me to be better at helping and supporting others who are facing the same challenges I once did show me how my own difficulties can teach me unique ways to assist those who are going through similar tough times loving God I ask you to use my experiences as a way to connect with others to give

them strength and Hope thank you for allowing me the privilege of sharing your comfort healing and kindness with those who are in need give me the ability to speak with wisdom kindness and courage to those who are seeking the light and love of Jesus let your comfort and strength shine brightly through me so that those who are struggling can find Hope and stability in you Lord I also lift up my loved ones to you please watch over and bless them in

all aspects of their lives provide them with your guidance protection and peace may they feel your presence and experience your love in a powerful way thank you for today's reminder that storms though painful have purpose you deliberately design and coordinate them to grow shape equip and transform me into Christ's likeness For Your Glory Grant me Supernatural joy and peace as I trust your goodness and faithfulness even when I cannot see where the waves are taking me you are the all-wise and

loving father who knows exactly what I need to become I come to you with a thankful heart asking for your blessings upon me and my family in the days and weeks ahead please watch over us guide us and keep us safe as we journey through life fill our days with your love joy and peace help us to face any challenges with strength and wisdom knowing that you are always with us may our relationships be strong and may we support and care

for each other in the way that you taught us bless our endeavors both big and small and help us to shine your light wherever we go thank you for your unwavering love and grace in Jesus's mighty name I pray amen if you were blessed by this message type the word amen in the comment section below you can help us to reach more persons and spread the gospel you can do this by sharing the video with a friend or family member and

by clicking the like button also remember to subscribe to the channel for more videos that will bless your heart and uplift your spirit we appreciate all your support you're blessed to be a blessing please feel free to leave your prayer requests in the comment section so that we can present them before God for your blessings and Victory and we also invite other believers on the YouTube platform and all over the world to join us and start praying for you right now
to God be all the glory I declare that all the blessings of this prayer are now upon you in the name of Jesus May the grace and peace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all thank you thank you
